newsitem.title: USA: Corp bond public issuance slows, 144a junks move in.
newsitem.headline: Corp bond public issuance slows, 144a junks move in.

text.p: A few issues coming from the 144a private placement market are expected to comprise Wednesday's bulk of new issue activity as Fed policy-makers head into the final leg of their two-day meeting, dealers said.

"Despite players expecting the Fed to keep interest rates steady issuers remained sidelined...we're not expecting any business untill after the meeting and the holiday," said one high-grade syndicate official.
Meanwhile, more than $1.0 billion in new private placement 144A offerings are slated to hit the market, players said.
